title: Health as text
prompt: The screen needs the robot's health as text. Return "Health: " followed by the number, so 80 gives "Health: 80". Joining a number straight onto text is an error.
hints: Text and numbers are different types; convert the number first.

docs.name: str(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as text (a String).

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings. Joining text to a number is an error; convert first.
